family: N13 option-implied downside asymmetry for directional futures signals
counting: One family across BTC/ETH and any variants; no option positions. Distinctness still requires evidence that it is not merely a renamed price/flow strategy.

source.interval: Half-open UTC daily windows; endpoint end_timestamp=exclusive_end-1 millisecond.
source.integrity: Require complete non-truncated time coverage, raw/gzip/receipt checksums, global unique identity audit and exact parent-to-leaf reconciliation before preparing the financial screen. Conflicting copies never get selected by performance.
source.metadata: Join every actual trade name to official instrument metadata. Require kind=option, matching base currency and price_index btc_usd/eth_usd, positive strike and valid creation/expiration timestamps. Determine activity at trade time from creation<=trade<expiration, never from current is_active/state. A missing or inconsistent required descriptor disqualifies aggregation; never infer it only from the instrument name.
source.quoteCurrency: Inverse-option premium quote_currency may equal BTC or ETH; do not misread that as the unit of the USD strike/underlying index. price_index determines matching of the underlying used for moneyness.
source.availability: Current historical trade and contract responses do not prove original publication or unrevised vintages. The historical screen is exploratory only.

dailyFeature.label: T is the exact end of [T-86400,T) UTC seconds; trades use source millisecond timestamps without rounding.
dailyFeature.validTrade: Unique trade_id within currency, finite positive iv and index_price, active option, expiry between 7 and 35 days inclusive measured at the trade timestamp.
dailyFeature.aggregation: Unweighted median native iv of puts minus unweighted median native iv of calls. Ignore current mark_iv. Exact copies count once; conflicting copies fail.
dailyFeature.units: Keep the native iv unit. A common positive constant rescaling preserves both skew sign and its comparison to a past percentile; no claim of absolute annualized-percent units.
dailyFeature.missing: Incomplete coverage cannot be a valid feature. A complete day with fewer than five eligible trades on either side is an invalid feature, retained as such, never filled/interpolated.

signal.threshold: Nearest rank ceil(0.60*90)=54 from exactly 90 prior consecutive valid daily skews, excluding current.
signal.condition: Current skew strictly positive and strictly greater than the prior-only percentile.
signal.entry: Next H1 open at T+7200 seconds; signal key=decision_time=T+3600; feature_end=T. No intervening price return used for selection.
signal.prospective: The raw counts/iv and instrument attributes must be bound to exact bytes/hash/vintages received by the relevant decision. The coverage proof must itself be received after the daily interval ends and no later than T+1h; without that separate receipt, the daily feature is invalid. Prior daily features use their own original T+1h receipt cutoff. Exact repeated payloads select the earliest valid receipt, irrespective of input order. The pure generator checks supplied receipt timing but cannot authenticate caller evidence; collector/replay verification remains mandatory. Historical mode must be explicit.

execution.engine: scripts/goal_execution_v4.py after synthetic tests, independent review and source freeze
execution.funding: Realized archived USD-M funding with direction-correct cash flow, conservative ambiguous entry/exit eligibility and adverse mark bounds where settlement mark is missing.
execution.quality: Any execution-quality flag disqualifies the trial. No source gap may retroactively cancel a price-observed entry.
execution.contractLimit: This is a Binance USD-M research executor; The5ers contract equivalence and executable costs remain unproven.

selection: Freeze protocol, raw/normalized source manifests, audited inputs, code and tests before computing real daily features, signal counts or financial performance. Count development 2022-01-01 inclusive to 2025-01-01 exclusive first; fewer than 100 triggers ends without PnL. Otherwise evaluate development base and stress once. Any failed gate ends without evaluation-window rescue, parameter reversal or renaming.
approval: Neither a data audit nor a historical pass increases the validated count. Global independent/prospective, statistical, execution and software requirements still apply.
